rationale: This is a motor-vehicle collision claim involving damage to the policyholder's vehicle and resulting injuries from the impact.
claim_summary: Rear-end collision on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 AM yesterday. Policyholder's vehicle is totaled with severe trunk and back-seat crush damage. Policyholder reports whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's information is documented on the police report. Deductible: $750; policy limit: $100,000.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle at approximately 35 mph; other driver did not brake
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.other_insurance: other driver's information on police report

rationale: A tree fell on the policyholder's own parked car, causing damage to the hood and windshield—this is comprehensive auto coverage (weather/tree damage to the vehicle).
claim_summary: Policyholder's maple tree fell on parked car in driveway during windstorm last night, damaging hood and windshield. Vehicle was unoccupied. Comprehensive auto claim under POL-1005 (active bundle policy, $1,000 deductible, $400,000 limit).
